Codex CLI in a lightweight editor terminal
Interface for opening chats from history and creating new sessions.
Full path to Codex CLI. When empty, use the current installed Codex package, then PATH, ~/.local/bin, or the official extension.
Generate a terminal chat title from its first message. Uses one short model request with your current Codex account and consumes account usage. Graphical chats use the official title generation.
Model for short terminal chat titles. Defaults to the lightweight model used by the installed official extension.
